v0.8 · 지란지교시큐리티 기획팀 디자인파트

Date Picker

날짜를 YYYY. MM. DD 순서로 입력하거나 달력에서 고릅니다. Text Field 위에 만들어 숫자만 치면 형식이 채워지고, 단위(연 · 월 · 일) · 기간 · 표기 언어(locale) · 기준 시간대(timezone)를 정할 수 있습니다. 값이 늘 유효한 날짜는 아닙니다 — 덜 친 날짜 · 없는 날짜 · 범위 밖 날짜도 상태로 남습니다.

1. Default

날짜 하나를 입력하는 기본 필드입니다. 숫자만 치면 YYYY. MM. DD 로 끊어 채워집니다(20260907 → 2026. 09. 07, 월에 9 를 치면 09). ↑↓ 는 커서가 놓인 조각(연 · 월 · 일)을 하나씩 올리고 내립니다. 달력 버튼이나 Alt+↓ 로 달력을 열면 달력 하나에서 고릅니다.

HTML
<div class="datepicker field"><label for="dp-default">점검일</label><div class="affix"><input id="dp-default" placeholder="YYYY. MM. DD" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off"><button type="button" class="cal-btn" aria-label="달력 열기" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h12a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v12a2 2 0 0 1 -2 2h-12a2 2 0 0 1 -2 -2v-12"/><path d="M16 3v4"/><path d="M8 3v4"/><path d="M4 11h16"/><path d="M11 15h1"/><path d="M12 15v3"/></svg></button></div></div>
CSS · .datepicker, .calendar, .field
/* JS Design System v0.8 · .datepicker, .calendar, .field · 토큰(var(--*))은 assets/style.css :root 참고 */
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:260px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.field label{font-weight:600}
.field label em{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong);font-style:normal;margin-left:2px}
.field input,.field textarea{height:40px;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:0 14px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);width:100%;transition:border-color var(--motion-fast),box-shadow var(--motion-fast)}
.field textarea{height:auto;min-height:96px;padding:10px 14px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary)}
.field input:hover,.field textarea:hover{border-color:var(--line-neutral-primary)}
.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus-within{border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-brand-focus);outline:none}
.field input:disabled,.field textarea:disabled{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.field input:read-only:not(:disabled){background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.field .help{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);font-size:12px;contain:inline-size;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.field.error input,.field.error textarea,.field.error .affix{border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary)}
.field.error input:focus,.field.error textarea:focus-within,.field.error .affix:has(input:focus){border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-negative-focus)}
.field.error .help{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.field.sm input{height:32px;font-size:12px;padding:0 12px}
.field.lg input{height:48px;font-size:16px;padding:0 16px}
.field .affix{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:var(--surface-elevated-primary)}
.field .affix input{border:0;height:auto;padding:0;flex:1;background:transparent;outline:0;min-width:0}
.field .affix input:focus,.field.error .affix input:focus{box-shadow:none}
.field .affix:has(input:focus){border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-brand-focus);outline:none}
.field.sm .affix{height:32px;padding:0 10px}
.field.lg .affix{height:48px;padding:0 14px}
.field .affix:has(input:disabled){background:var(--surface-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.field .affix:has(input:read-only:not(:disabled)){background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.field .affix span{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
.field .counter{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary)}
.field .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.datepicker{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;position:relative;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.datepicker label{font-weight:600}
.datepicker.field[data-range]{min-width:300px}
.datepicker.open:not(.error) .affix{border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.datepicker .cal-btn{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;margin-right:-6px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);cursor:pointer}
.datepicker .cal-btn:hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.datepicker .cal-btn:active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.datepicker .cal-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.datepicker .cal-btn:disabled{background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.datepicker .calendar{position:absolute;top:var(--dp-top,calc(100% + 4px));left:var(--dp-left,0);z-index:5;display:none}
.datepicker.open .calendar{display:block}
.calendar{width:296px;padding:20px;background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-2);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
.calendar .cal-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:600;padding:0 4px 8px}
.calendar .cal-head button{border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-head button:hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-head button:active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .cal-head button{display:grid;place-items:center}
.calendar .cal-head button svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.calendar .cal-head .cal-title{width:auto;padding:0 8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.calendar .cal-nav-gap{width:28px;flex:none}
.calendar .cal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);row-gap:2px;text-align:center}
.calendar .cal-week{display:contents}
.calendar .dow{font-size:12px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);padding:4px 0;font-weight:600}
.calendar .day{position:relative;isolation:isolate;height:34px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);cursor:pointer}
.calendar .day:hover:not(.on,.in-range,.preview,.preview-end,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .day:active:not(.on,.in-range,.preview,.preview-end,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .day.muted{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary)}
.calendar .day.today{font-weight:700;color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.in-range,.calendar .day.preview{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day.in-range:hover,.calendar .day.preview:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.on{color:var(--brand-label);font-weight:600}
.calendar .day.on::before,.calendar .day.preview-end::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;margin:auto;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.preview-end::before{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.start:not(.end){background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 50%,var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong) 50%);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day.end:not(.start){background:linear-gradient(to left,transparent 50%,var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong) 50%);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day[disabled],.calendar .day[aria-disabled="true"]{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.calendar .day.blank{visibility:hidden}
.calendar .day:focus-visible,.calendar .cell:focus-visible{position:relative;z-index:1}
.calendar .cal-grid.years,.calendar .cal-grid.months{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px}
.calendar .cell{height:40px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);cursor:pointer}
.calendar .cell:hover:not(.on,.in-range,[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cell:active:not(.on,.in-range,[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .cell.today{font-weight:700;color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .cell.on{background:var(--surface-brand-primary);color:var(--brand-label);font-weight:600}
.calendar .cell.in-range{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.calendar .cell.in-range:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-brand-primary)}
.calendar .cell[aria-disabled="true"]{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.calendar.two{width:auto}
.calendar .cal-months{display:flex;gap:24px}
.calendar .cal-month{width:270px}
.calendar .cal-foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;padding-top:10px;margin-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-foot .btn.text+.btn:not(.text){margin-left:auto}
.form .form-row .field{min-width:0}
.form .field{min-width:0}
React · @jiran/ds-react
import { DatePicker } from "@jiran/ds-react";

/* 숫자만 치면 YYYY. MM. DD 로 끊어 채운다. ↑↓ 는 커서 조각 ±1, 달력 버튼 · Alt+↓ 로 달력 하나에서 고른다 */
export default function Example() {
  return <DatePicker label="점검일" onChange={(value, { validity }) => console.log(value, validity)} />;
}

2. Date Range Picker

기간(조회 기간)은 data-range 입니다. 달력 두 개가 기본이라 달을 넘는 기간을 한 번에 고르고, 좁은 화면(767px 이하)이나 data-calendars="1" 에서는 하나로 줄어듭니다. 입력은 YYYY. MM. DD ~ YYYY. MM. DD — 앞 날짜가 다 차면 ~ 뒤로 넘어갑니다. data-max="today" 로 미래 날짜는 고를 수 없습니다.

HTML
<div class="datepicker field" data-range data-max="today" data-presets="7 30"><label for="dp-range">조회 기간</label><div class="affix"><input id="dp-range" value="2026. 09. 01 ~ 2026. 09. 07" placeholder="YYYY. MM. DD ~ YYYY. MM. DD" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off"><button type="button" class="cal-btn" aria-label="달력 열기" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h12a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v12a2 2 0 0 1 -2 2h-12a2 2 0 0 1 -2 -2v-12"/><path d="M16 3v4"/><path d="M8 3v4"/><path d="M4 11h16"/><path d="M11 15h1"/><path d="M12 15v3"/></svg></button></div></div>

React · @jiran/ds-react
import { DateRangePicker } from "@jiran/ds-react";

const today = new Date();
const daysAgo = (n: number) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() - n);

/* 기간(조회 기간) — 달력 두 개가 기본(767px 이하에서는 하나). 미래 날짜는 고를 수 없다 */
export default function Example() {
  return (
    <DateRangePicker
      label="조회 기간"
      max={today}
      presets={[
        { label: "최근 7일", range: () => [daysAgo(6), today] },
        { label: "최근 30일", range: () => [daysAgo(29), today] },
      ]}
      defaultValue={{ start: new Date(2026, 8, 1), end: new Date(2026, 8, 7) }}
      onChange={({ start, end }, { validity }) => console.log(start, end, validity)}
    />
  );
}

3. Unit

data-unit 으로 고르는 단위를 정합니다. year 는 YYYY 와 12년 연도 목록, month 는 YYYY. MM 과 월 목록, day(기본)는 YYYY. MM. DD 와 날짜 달력입니다. 확정 값(data-value)은 단위의 기계 형식(2026 · 2026-09 · 2026-09-07)입니다.

HTML

CSS · .datepicker, .calendar, .field
/* JS Design System v0.8 · .datepicker, .calendar, .field · 토큰(var(--*))은 assets/style.css :root 참고 */
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:260px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.field label{font-weight:600}
.field label em{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong);font-style:normal;margin-left:2px}
.field input,.field textarea{height:40px;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:0 14px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);width:100%;transition:border-color var(--motion-fast),box-shadow var(--motion-fast)}
.field textarea{height:auto;min-height:96px;padding:10px 14px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary)}
.field input:hover,.field textarea:hover{border-color:var(--line-neutral-primary)}
.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus-within{border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-brand-focus);outline:none}
.field input:disabled,.field textarea:disabled{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.field input:read-only:not(:disabled){background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.field .help{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);font-size:12px;contain:inline-size;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.field.error input,.field.error textarea,.field.error .affix{border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary)}
.field.error input:focus,.field.error textarea:focus-within,.field.error .affix:has(input:focus){border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-negative-focus)}
.field.error .help{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.field.sm input{height:32px;font-size:12px;padding:0 12px}
.field.lg input{height:48px;font-size:16px;padding:0 16px}
.field .affix{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:var(--surface-elevated-primary)}
.field .affix input{border:0;height:auto;padding:0;flex:1;background:transparent;outline:0;min-width:0}
.field .affix input:focus,.field.error .affix input:focus{box-shadow:none}
.field .affix:has(input:focus){border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-brand-focus);outline:none}
.field.sm .affix{height:32px;padding:0 10px}
.field.lg .affix{height:48px;padding:0 14px}
.field .affix:has(input:disabled){background:var(--surface-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.field .affix:has(input:read-only:not(:disabled)){background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.field .affix span{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
.field .counter{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary)}
.field .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.datepicker{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;position:relative;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.datepicker label{font-weight:600}
.datepicker.field[data-range]{min-width:300px}
.datepicker.open:not(.error) .affix{border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.datepicker .cal-btn{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;margin-right:-6px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);cursor:pointer}
.datepicker .cal-btn:hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.datepicker .cal-btn:active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.datepicker .cal-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.datepicker .cal-btn:disabled{background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.datepicker .calendar{position:absolute;top:var(--dp-top,calc(100% + 4px));left:var(--dp-left,0);z-index:5;display:none}
.datepicker.open .calendar{display:block}
.calendar{width:296px;padding:20px;background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-2);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
.calendar .cal-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:600;padding:0 4px 8px}
.calendar .cal-head button{border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-head button:hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-head button:active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .cal-head button{display:grid;place-items:center}
.calendar .cal-head button svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.calendar .cal-head .cal-title{width:auto;padding:0 8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.calendar .cal-nav-gap{width:28px;flex:none}
.calendar .cal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);row-gap:2px;text-align:center}
.calendar .cal-week{display:contents}
.calendar .dow{font-size:12px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);padding:4px 0;font-weight:600}
.calendar .day{position:relative;isolation:isolate;height:34px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);cursor:pointer}
.calendar .day:hover:not(.on,.in-range,.preview,.preview-end,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .day:active:not(.on,.in-range,.preview,.preview-end,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .day.muted{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary)}
.calendar .day.today{font-weight:700;color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.in-range,.calendar .day.preview{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day.in-range:hover,.calendar .day.preview:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.on{color:var(--brand-label);font-weight:600}
.calendar .day.on::before,.calendar .day.preview-end::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;margin:auto;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.preview-end::before{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.start:not(.end){background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 50%,var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong) 50%);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day.end:not(.start){background:linear-gradient(to left,transparent 50%,var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong) 50%);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day[disabled],.calendar .day[aria-disabled="true"]{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.calendar .day.blank{visibility:hidden}
.calendar .day:focus-visible,.calendar .cell:focus-visible{position:relative;z-index:1}
.calendar .cal-grid.years,.calendar .cal-grid.months{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px}
.calendar .cell{height:40px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);cursor:pointer}
.calendar .cell:hover:not(.on,.in-range,[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cell:active:not(.on,.in-range,[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .cell.today{font-weight:700;color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .cell.on{background:var(--surface-brand-primary);color:var(--brand-label);font-weight:600}
.calendar .cell.in-range{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.calendar .cell.in-range:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-brand-primary)}
.calendar .cell[aria-disabled="true"]{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.calendar.two{width:auto}
.calendar .cal-months{display:flex;gap:24px}
.calendar .cal-month{width:270px}
.calendar .cal-foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;padding-top:10px;margin-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-foot .btn.text+.btn:not(.text){margin-left:auto}
.form .form-row .field{min-width:0}
.form .field{min-width:0}
React · @jiran/ds-react
import { DatePicker } from "@jiran/ds-react";

/* unit — year: YYYY + 12년 연도 목록 · month: YYYY. MM + 월 목록 · day(기본): YYYY. MM. DD + 날짜 달력 */
export default function Example() {
  return (
    <>
      <DatePicker label="보고 연도" unit="year" defaultValue={new Date(2026, 0, 1)} />
      <DatePicker label="보고서 월" unit="month" defaultValue={new Date(2026, 8, 1)} />
      <DatePicker label="점검일" defaultValue={new Date(2026, 8, 7)} />
    </>
  );
}

4. Calendar

열린 상태의 달력. 오늘(.today · aria-current), 선택(.on · aria-selected), 다른 달(.muted), 선택 불가(data-max 밖 · aria-disabled). 제목을 누르면 연 → 월로 빠르게 옮깁니다.

CSS · .datepicker, .calendar, .btn, .sr-only
/* JS Design System v0.8 · .datepicker, .calendar, .btn, .sr-only · 토큰(var(--*))은 assets/style.css :root 참고 */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:40px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;transition:background var(--motion-fast),border-color var(--motion-fast)}
.btn.sm{height:32px;padding:0 14px;font-size:12px}
.btn.md{height:40px;padding:0 20px;font-size:14px}
.btn.lg{height:48px;padding:0 26px;font-size:16px}
.btn:where(.solid.primary){background:var(--surface-brand-primary);color:var(--brand-label)}
.btn:where(.solid.primary):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.primary):active{background:var(--surface-brand-heavy)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary){border-color:var(--line-brand-strong);color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive){background:var(--surface-neutral-tertiary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive){border-color:var(--line-neutral-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative){background:var(--surface-negative-primary);color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative):active{background:var(--surface-negative-heavy)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative){border-color:var(--line-negative-primary);color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-hover)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative):active{background:var(--surface-negative-pressed);border-color:var(--line-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.text){color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn.text{padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px}
.btn:where(.text):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.text):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive){color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn.icon-only{width:40px;padding:0}
.btn.icon-only.sm{width:32px}
.btn.icon-only.lg{width:48px}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary){color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive){color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative){color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-hover)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative):active{background:var(--surface-negative-pressed)}

.btn:where(.outline)[disabled],.btn:where(.outline)[aria-disabled="true"]{background:transparent;border-color:var(--surface-disable-primary)}
.btn:where(.text,.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline))[disabled],.btn:where(.text,.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline))[aria-disabled="true"]{background:transparent}
.btn.loading{position:relative;color:transparent;cursor:progress}
.btn.loading::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:16px;height:16px;border:2px solid currentColor;border-right-color:transparent;border-radius:50%;color:var(--brand-label);animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
.btn:where(.assistive).loading::after{color:var(--surface-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary,.text:not(.assistive),.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.negative:not(.text)).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.datepicker{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;position:relative;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.datepicker label{font-weight:600}
.datepicker.field[data-range]{min-width:300px}
.datepicker.open:not(.error) .affix{border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.datepicker .cal-btn{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;margin-right:-6px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);cursor:pointer}
.datepicker .cal-btn:hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.datepicker .cal-btn:active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.datepicker .cal-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.datepicker .cal-btn:disabled{background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.datepicker .calendar{position:absolute;top:var(--dp-top,calc(100% + 4px));left:var(--dp-left,0);z-index:5;display:none}
.datepicker.open .calendar{display:block}
.calendar{width:296px;padding:20px;background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-2);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
.calendar .cal-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:600;padding:0 4px 8px}
.calendar .cal-head button{border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-head button:hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-head button:active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .cal-head button{display:grid;place-items:center}
.calendar .cal-head button svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.calendar .cal-head .cal-title{width:auto;padding:0 8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.calendar .cal-nav-gap{width:28px;flex:none}
.calendar .cal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);row-gap:2px;text-align:center}
.calendar .cal-week{display:contents}
.calendar .dow{font-size:12px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);padding:4px 0;font-weight:600}
.calendar .day{position:relative;isolation:isolate;height:34px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);cursor:pointer}
.calendar .day:hover:not(.on,.in-range,.preview,.preview-end,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .day:active:not(.on,.in-range,.preview,.preview-end,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .day.muted{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary)}
.calendar .day.today{font-weight:700;color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.in-range,.calendar .day.preview{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day.in-range:hover,.calendar .day.preview:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.on{color:var(--brand-label);font-weight:600}
.calendar .day.on::before,.calendar .day.preview-end::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;margin:auto;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.preview-end::before{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.start:not(.end){background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 50%,var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong) 50%);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day.end:not(.start){background:linear-gradient(to left,transparent 50%,var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong) 50%);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day[disabled],.calendar .day[aria-disabled="true"]{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.calendar .day.blank{visibility:hidden}
.calendar .day:focus-visible,.calendar .cell:focus-visible{position:relative;z-index:1}
.calendar .cal-grid.years,.calendar .cal-grid.months{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px}
.calendar .cell{height:40px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);cursor:pointer}
.calendar .cell:hover:not(.on,.in-range,[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cell:active:not(.on,.in-range,[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}

.calendar .cell[aria-disabled="true"]{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.calendar.two{width:auto}

.banner .btn{margin-left:auto}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.action-bar .btn:not(.text,.icon-only){padding:0 12px}
.empty .btn{margin-top:10px}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
React · @jiran/ds-react
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Calendar } from "@jiran/ds-react";

const TODAY = new Date(2026, 8, 7);

export default function Example() {
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(new Date(2026, 8, 1));
  /* 날짜를 누르면 초안, 적용을 눌러야 확정 — 사이트 예제와 같다 */
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Date | null>(TODAY);
  const [value, setValue] = useState<Date | null>(TODAY);
  return (
    <Calendar
      month={month}
      onMonthChange={setMonth}
      value={draft}
      onSelect={setDraft}
      today={TODAY}
      max={new Date(2026, 8, 30)}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="text" size="sm" data-cal="today" onClick={() => { setMonth(new Date(2026, 8, 1)); setDraft(TODAY); }}>오늘</Button>
          <Button size="sm" data-cal="apply" disabled={draft?.getTime() === value?.getTime()} onClick={() => setValue(draft)}>적용</Button>
        </>
      }
    />
  );
}

5. Range Calendar

기간 달력은 두 달을 나란히 봅니다. 시작 · 끝은 .on(.start · .end), 사이는 .in-range. 시작만 고른 동안에는 포인터를 올린 날까지 미리 보여 주고, 적용은 끝을 고른 뒤에 켜집니다. 두 달 보기에서 다른 달 칸은 비워 같은 날짜가 두 번 나오지 않습니다.

React · @jiran/ds-react
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Calendar, type DateRange } from "@jiran/ds-react";

const TODAY = new Date(2026, 9, 7);
const daysAgo = (n: number) => new Date(TODAY.getFullYear(), TODAY.getMonth(), TODAY.getDate() - n);

/* 기간 달력은 두 달이 기본이다(calendars={1} 로 한 달) */
export default function Example() {
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(new Date(2026, 8, 1));
  const [range, setRange] = useState<DateRange>({ start: new Date(2026, 8, 21), end: TODAY });
  const [applied, setApplied] = useState<DateRange>(range);
  const same = range.start.getTime() === applied.start.getTime() && range.end?.getTime() === applied.end?.getTime();
  /* 첫 클릭은 시작, 둘째 클릭은 끝(앞이면 바꾼다). 프리셋은 고르는 즉시 적용한다 — 사이트(ds.js)와 DateRangePicker 가 그렇다 */
  const preset = (n: number) => { const r = { start: daysAgo(n - 1), end: TODAY }; setRange(r); setApplied(r); };
  const pick = (d: Date) => setRange((r) => (!r.end ? (d < r.start ? { start: d, end: r.start } : { start: r.start, end: d }) : { start: d, end: null }));
  return (
    <Calendar
      month={month}
      onMonthChange={setMonth}
      mode="range"
      value={range}
      onSelect={pick}
      today={TODAY}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="text" size="sm" onClick={() => preset(7)}>최근 7일</Button>
          <Button variant="text" size="sm" onClick={() => preset(30)}>최근 30일</Button>
          <Button size="sm" data-cal="apply" disabled={!range.end || same} onClick={() => setApplied(range)}>적용</Button>
        </>
      }
    />
  );
}

6. Min · Max

data-min · data-max 밖의 날짜는 달력에서 고를 수 없습니다(aria-disabled). 키보드로는 범위 밖 값도 들어갑니다 — 직접 치거나 ↑↓ 로 조각을 넘기면 값은 그 날짜로 남고, 오류 테두리와 원인 문구가 붙습니다(data-validity="max"). 문구는 무엇이 일어났는지와 고칠 방법 두 부분이고, 범위는 '부터 · 까지'(그 날짜 포함)로 씁니다 — data-messages(JSON, React 는 messages)로 바꿉니다.

2026년 안의 날짜
날짜가 범위를 벗어났습니다. 2026. 12. 31 까지 입력할 수 있습니다.

React · @jiran/ds-react
import { DatePicker } from "@jiran/ds-react";

/* 달력은 min · max 밖을 고를 수 없다. 키보드(직접 입력 · ↑↓)로는 들어가고, 값은 그 날짜로 남은 채 validity "max" 와 오류 문구가 붙는다 */
export default function Example() {
  const min = new Date(2026, 0, 1), max = new Date(2026, 11, 31);
  return (
    <>
      <DatePicker label="점검일" min={min} max={max} defaultValue={new Date(2026, 8, 7)} help="2026년 안의 날짜" />
      <DatePicker label="점검일" min={min} max={max} defaultValue={new Date(2027, 0, 5)} help="2026년 안의 날짜" onChange={(value, { validity }) => console.log(value, validity)} />
    </>
  );
}

7. Invalid Date

값이 늘 유효한 날짜는 아닙니다. 덜 친 날짜는 incomplete, 없는 날짜(2월 30일)는 invalid 로 남습니다 — 확정 값(data-value)은 비고 ds:date 의 date 는 Invalid Date 입니다. 오류는 Enter 를 누르거나 포커스가 필드를 떠날 때 보입니다.

날짜가 덜 입력됐습니다. 2026. 09. 07 처럼 끝까지 입력하세요.
날짜가 달력에 없습니다. 달력에서 고르거나 2026. 09. 07 처럼 입력하세요.

import { DatePicker } from "@jiran/ds-react";

/* 값이 늘 유효한 날짜는 아니다 — 덜 친 날짜(incomplete) · 없는 날짜(invalid)는 onChange 로 Invalid Date 가 온다 */
export default function Example() {
  return (
    <>
      <DatePicker label="시작일" defaultText="2026. 09" help="점검을 시작한 날" onChange={(value, { validity }) => console.log(isNaN(value?.getTime() ?? 0), validity)} />
      <DatePicker label="종료일" defaultText="2026. 02. 30" help="점검을 끝낸 날" />
    </>
  );
}

8. Locale

data-locale 로 달력 표기 언어를 바꿉니다(기본 ko-KR). 제목 · 요일 · 월 이름 · 날짜 칸의 접근 이름 · '오늘' 버튼을 Intl 로 만들어, Intl 이 지원하는 언어는 따로 불러오지 않고 씁니다. Intl 에 없는 문구(적용 · 이전 달 · 다음 달 …)는 data-labels(JSON, React 는 labels)로 바꿉니다. 필드 입력 형식은 언어와 무관하게 YYYY. MM. DD 입니다.

React · @jiran/ds-react
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Calendar, type DatePickerLabels } from "@jiran/ds-react";

const TODAY = new Date(2026, 8, 7);

/* locale — 제목 · 요일 · 월 이름 · 접근 이름 · '오늘' 을 Intl 로. Intl 이 지원하는 언어는 import 없이 쓴다.
   Intl 에 없는 문구(적용 · 이전 달 …)는 labels 로 — 사이트 data-labels 와 같은 키 */
const LABELS: Record<string, Partial<DatePickerLabels>> = {
  "en-US": { dialog: "Choose date", apply: "Apply", prevMonth: "Previous month", nextMonth: "Next month", chooseYear: "choose year" },
  "ja-JP": { dialog: "日付を選択", apply: "適用", prevMonth: "前の月", nextMonth: "次の月", chooseYear: "年を選択" },
};

function Localized({ locale, today }: { locale: string; today: string }) {
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(new Date(2026, 8, 1));
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Date | null>(TODAY);
  return (
    <Calendar
      locale={locale}
      labels={LABELS[locale]}
      month={month}
      onMonthChange={setMonth}
      value={draft}
      onSelect={setDraft}
      today={TODAY}
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="text" size="sm" data-cal="today" onClick={() => setDraft(TODAY)}>{today}</Button>
          <Button size="sm" data-cal="apply" disabled={draft?.getTime() === TODAY.getTime()}>{LABELS[locale].apply}</Button>
        </>
      }
    />
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <>
      <Localized locale="en-US" today="Today" />
      <Localized locale="ja-JP" today="今日" />
    </>
  );
}

9. Timezone

data-timezone 으로 '오늘'과 값의 기준 시간대를 정합니다(기본은 사용자 환경). dayjs 가 지원하는 IANA 이름과 UTC 를 그대로 씁니다 — ds.js 는 dayjs · utc · timezone 플러그인이 실린 페이지에서 계산하고, 확정 때 ds:date 의 date 로 그 시간대의 0시를 줍니다. 같은 순간이라도 뉴욕은 서울보다 하루 늦을 수 있어, '오늘까지'가 가리키는 날이 다릅니다.

UTC 의 오늘까지
America/New_York 의 오늘까지

CSS · .datepicker, .calendar, .field
/* JS Design System v0.8 · .datepicker, .calendar, .field · 토큰(var(--*))은 assets/style.css :root 참고 */
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:260px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.field label{font-weight:600}
.field label em{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong);font-style:normal;margin-left:2px}
.field input,.field textarea{height:40px;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:0 14px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);width:100%;transition:border-color var(--motion-fast),box-shadow var(--motion-fast)}
.field textarea{height:auto;min-height:96px;padding:10px 14px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary)}
.field input:hover,.field textarea:hover{border-color:var(--line-neutral-primary)}
.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus-within{border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-brand-focus);outline:none}
.field input:disabled,.field textarea:disabled{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.field input:read-only:not(:disabled){background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.field .help{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);font-size:12px;contain:inline-size;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.field.error input,.field.error textarea,.field.error .affix{border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary)}
.field.error input:focus,.field.error textarea:focus-within,.field.error .affix:has(input:focus){border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-negative-focus)}
.field.error .help{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}

React · @jiran/ds-react
import { DatePicker } from "@jiran/ds-react";

/* timezone — '오늘'과 값(그 시간대의 0시)의 기준. dayjs 가 지원하는 IANA 이름과 UTC 를 import 없이 쓴다(기본은 사용자 환경) */
export default function Example() {
  const now = new Date();
  return (
    <>
      <DatePicker label="UTC 기준" timezone="UTC" max={now} help="UTC 의 오늘까지" onChange={(value) => console.log(value?.toISOString())} />
      <DatePicker label="뉴욕 기준" timezone="America/New_York" max={now} help="America/New_York 의 오늘까지" />
    </>
  );
}

10. Footer

하단 버튼은 data-footer 로 고릅니다 — 오늘 · 초기화 · 취소(열기 전 값으로) · 적용. none 이면 버튼 없이 고르는 순간 적용하고 닫힙니다(기간은 끝을 고를 때).

12. State

비활성은 비활성 토큰으로 칠하고 달력을 열지 않습니다. 읽기 전용은 값만 보이고 달력을 열지 않습니다.

Props

HTML 에서는 클래스와 속성으로, React(@jiran/ds-react)에서는 같은 이름의 prop(variant · size …)으로 변형·상태를 지정합니다.

Prop / ClassType · ValuesDefaultDescription
.datepicker.field
container—Text Field 셸 — label + .affix(input + .cal-btn) + .help, 열면 .calendar. 열림은 .open, 위로 펼침은 .up
data-unit
day | month | year
day
입력 형식(YYYY. MM. DD · YYYY. MM · YYYY) · 달력 첫 화면 · 고르는 단위
data-range
boolean—기간(Date Range Picker). 달력 2개가 기본(일 단위). 월 · 연 단위는 칸 하나에 12개라 1개
data-valuedata-startdata-end
YYYY-MM-DD · YYYY-MM · YYYY—확정 값(기계 형식). 미완성 · 없는 날짜면 비고, 범위 밖 · 순서 오류면 그 날짜가 남는다
data-validity
empty | incomplete | invalid | min | max | order | valid—ds.js 가 쓴다. 유효 · 빈 값도 적는다(React 와 같다)
data-locale
BCP 47 태그
ko-KR
달력 제목 · 요일 · 월 이름 · 접근 이름 · '오늘'(Intl). 입력 형식은 바뀌지 않는다
data-labels
JSON
한국어
Intl 이 만들지 못하는 문구 — dialog · apply · cancel · reset · today · prevMonth · nextMonth · prevYear · nextYear · prevYears · nextYears · chooseYear · yearGrid · backToDays · backToMonths · recent("최근 {n}일"). 키는 React labels 와 같다. 오류 문구는 data-messages
data-messages
JSON
한국어
오류 문구 — incomplete · invalid · min · max · order 와 주어 subject("날짜가") · startSubject("시작일이") · endSubject("종료일이"). 자리표시 {subject} {example} {min} {max} 로 어순을 정한다 — 기간에서 한쪽만 틀리면 {subject} 가 그 쪽 이름. 자리표시가 없으면 옛 조합(앞말 + 예시 · 날짜 + 꼬리말). 키는 React messages 와 같다
data-timezone
IANA 이름 | UTC
사용자 환경
'오늘'과 ds:date 의 date(그 시간대 0시). dayjs + utc · timezone 플러그인이 실린 페이지에서 계산한다
data-mindata-max
YYYY-MM-DD | today—밖의 날짜 · 월 · 연은 달력에서 aria-disabled. 키보드 입력은 막지 않고 오류로 알린다
data-footer
today reset cancel apply | none
단일: today apply · 기간: apply
none 이면 고르는 순간 적용
data-calendars
1 | 2
기간 2
기간 달력 수. 767px 이하 1
data-presets
"7 30"—기간 프리셋(최근 N일). 누르는 즉시 확정한다(적용 버튼과 별개). min/max 밖이면 비활성
data-default-preset
N—값이 없으면 오늘 기준 최근 N일을 처음 값으로(기간)
data-today
YYYY-MM-DD
오늘
정적 데모용
.sm.lg
size
md
필드 높이 32 / 40 / 48
disabledreadonly
attribute—input 과 .cal-btn 에. 읽기 전용은 값만 보이고 달력을 열지 않는다
↑ ↓Alt+↓Enter
keyboard—입력에서: 커서 조각 ±1(min/max 무시) · 달력 열기 · 검사와 확정
.calendar
popover—.cal-head(.cal-nav · .cal-title) + .cal-grid[role=grid](.cal-week ×주 수 · .day 주 수×7, 28–42) + .cal-foot. 두 달은 .two > .cal-months > .cal-month ×2
.day.on.start.end.in-range.preview.today.muted
state—선택 / 기간 양끝 / 사이 / 미리보기 / 오늘 / 다른 달
.cell.on.in-range
state—월 · 연 단위의 선택 / 기간 사이
ds:date
event—값이 바뀔 때. {value, date, text, validity} · 기간 {value:"A ~ B", start, end, date:{start, end}, text, validity, sides:{start, end}} — sides 는 쪽마다의 상태(empty · incomplete · invalid · min · max · valid)

Usage

React: @jiran/ds-react 패키지를 설치하고 style.css 를 한 번 import 하면 위 React 탭 코드를 그대로 쓸 수 있습니다(React Package). HTML: assets/style.css 를 연결하고(일부만 필요하면 아래 컴포넌트 CSS 복사), 동작이 필요하면 assets/ds.js 를 함께 넣습니다 — 이 페이지의 프리뷰가 그 스크립트로 동작합니다. 색은 전부 토큰(var(--surface-brand-primary) 등)을 참조하므로 --accent-* 만 제품 컬러로 바꾸면 됩니다.

React @jiran/ds-react

npm i @jiran/ds-react

// main.tsx — 앱 진입점에서 한 번
import "@jiran/ds-react/style.css";

// 컴포넌트
import { Calendar, DatePicker, DateRangePicker, formatDate, parseDate } from "@jiran/ds-react";

HTML

<!-- 1) 토큰 + 전체 컴포넌트 스타일 한 번에 연결 -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/style.css">
<!-- 동작(드롭다운·탭·달력·표 정렬/선택·토스트 등) — 순수 JS 한 파일. React 제품은 불필요 -->
<script src="assets/ds.js" defer></script>

<!-- 2) 또는 아래 "Component CSS" 만 프로젝트 CSS 에 붙이고,
        :root 토큰은 Foundations › Design Token 에서 복사 -->

복사본의 전제

아래 "Component CSS" 만 붙일 때는 이 규칙들과 Pretendard(assets/fonts) · :root 토큰을 전제로 그려집니다 — assets/style.css 의 값 그대로입니다. 앱에 같은 규칙이 있으면 넣지 않아도 됩니다.

*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--background-neutral-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);font-family:var(--font-sans);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
code,kbd{font-family:var(--font-sans);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

Component CSS .datepicker, .calendar, .btn, .field, .sr-only

/* JS Design System v0.8 · .datepicker, .calendar, .btn, .field, .sr-only · 토큰(var(--*))은 assets/style.css :root 참고 */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:40px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;transition:background var(--motion-fast),border-color var(--motion-fast)}
.btn.sm{height:32px;padding:0 14px;font-size:12px}
.btn.md{height:40px;padding:0 20px;font-size:14px}
.btn.lg{height:48px;padding:0 26px;font-size:16px}
.btn:where(.solid.primary){background:var(--surface-brand-primary);color:var(--brand-label)}
.btn:where(.solid.primary):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.primary):active{background:var(--surface-brand-heavy)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary){border-color:var(--line-brand-strong);color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive){background:var(--surface-neutral-tertiary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.solid.assistive):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive){border-color:var(--line-neutral-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.outline.assistive):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative){background:var(--surface-negative-primary);color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.solid.negative):active{background:var(--surface-negative-heavy)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative){border-color:var(--line-negative-primary);color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-hover)}
.btn:where(.outline.negative):active{background:var(--surface-negative-pressed);border-color:var(--line-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.text){color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn.text{padding-left:8px;padding-right:8px}
.btn:where(.text):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.text):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive){color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.text.assistive):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn.icon-only{width:40px;padding:0}
.btn.icon-only.sm{width:32px}
.btn.icon-only.lg{width:48px}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary){color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary):hover{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary):active{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive){color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive):hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).assistive):active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative){color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative):hover{background:var(--surface-negative-hover)}
.btn:where(.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).negative):active{background:var(--surface-negative-pressed)}
.btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}
.btn.sm svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.btn.lg svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.btn.block{width:100%}
.btn[disabled],.btn[aria-disabled="true"]{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);border-color:transparent;color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none}
.btn:where(.outline)[disabled],.btn:where(.outline)[aria-disabled="true"]{background:transparent;border-color:var(--surface-disable-primary)}
.btn:where(.text,.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline))[disabled],.btn:where(.text,.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline))[aria-disabled="true"]{background:transparent}
.btn.loading{position:relative;color:transparent;cursor:progress}
.btn.loading::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:16px;height:16px;border:2px solid currentColor;border-right-color:transparent;border-radius:50%;color:var(--brand-label);animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
.btn:where(.assistive).loading::after{color:var(--surface-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.outline.primary,.text:not(.assistive),.icon-only:not(.solid,.outline).primary).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.btn:where(.negative:not(.text)).loading::after{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:260px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.field label{font-weight:600}
.field label em{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong);font-style:normal;margin-left:2px}
.field input,.field textarea{height:40px;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:0 14px;font:inherit;font-size:14px;background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);width:100%;transition:border-color var(--motion-fast),box-shadow var(--motion-fast)}
.field textarea{height:auto;min-height:96px;padding:10px 14px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary)}
.field input:hover,.field textarea:hover{border-color:var(--line-neutral-primary)}
.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus-within{border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-brand-focus);outline:none}
.field input:disabled,.field textarea:disabled{background:var(--surface-disable-primary);color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.field input:read-only:not(:disabled){background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.field .help{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);font-size:12px;contain:inline-size;word-break:keep-all;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.field.error input,.field.error textarea,.field.error .affix{border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary)}
.field.error input:focus,.field.error textarea:focus-within,.field.error .affix:has(input:focus){border-color:var(--foreground-negative-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-negative-focus)}
.field.error .help{color:var(--foreground-negative-strong)}
.field.sm input{height:32px;font-size:12px;padding:0 12px}
.field.lg input{height:48px;font-size:16px;padding:0 16px}
.field .affix{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:40px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-primary);border-radius:var(--radius-md);background:var(--surface-elevated-primary)}
.field .affix input{border:0;height:auto;padding:0;flex:1;background:transparent;outline:0;min-width:0}
.field .affix input:focus,.field.error .affix input:focus{box-shadow:none}
.field .affix:has(input:focus){border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--line-brand-focus);outline:none}
.field.sm .affix{height:32px;padding:0 10px}
.field.lg .affix{height:48px;padding:0 14px}
.field .affix:has(input:disabled){background:var(--surface-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.field .affix:has(input:read-only:not(:disabled)){background:var(--background-neutral-secondary)}
.field .affix span{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
.field .counter{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary)}
.field .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.datepicker{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;position:relative;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
.datepicker label{font-weight:600}
.datepicker.field[data-range]{min-width:300px}
.datepicker.open:not(.error) .affix{border-color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.datepicker .cal-btn{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;margin-right:-6px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);cursor:pointer}
.datepicker .cal-btn:hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.datepicker .cal-btn:active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.datepicker .cal-btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.datepicker .cal-btn:disabled{background:transparent;color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.datepicker .calendar{position:absolute;top:var(--dp-top,calc(100% + 4px));left:var(--dp-left,0);z-index:5;display:none}
.datepicker.open .calendar{display:block}
.calendar{width:296px;padding:20px;background:var(--surface-elevated-primary);border:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-2);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6}
.calendar .cal-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:600;padding:0 4px 8px}
.calendar .cal-head button{border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-head button:hover{background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-head button:active{background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .cal-head button{display:grid;place-items:center}
.calendar .cal-head button svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.calendar .cal-head .cal-title{width:auto;padding:0 8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary)}
.calendar .cal-nav-gap{width:28px;flex:none}
.calendar .cal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);row-gap:2px;text-align:center}
.calendar .cal-week{display:contents}
.calendar .dow{font-size:12px;color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary);padding:4px 0;font-weight:600}
.calendar .day{position:relative;isolation:isolate;height:34px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);cursor:pointer}
.calendar .day:hover:not(.on,.in-range,.preview,.preview-end,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .day:active:not(.on,.in-range,.preview,.preview-end,[disabled],[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .day.muted{color:var(--foreground-neutral-tertiary)}
.calendar .day.today{font-weight:700;color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.in-range,.calendar .day.preview{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day.in-range:hover,.calendar .day.preview:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.on{color:var(--brand-label);font-weight:600}
.calendar .day.on::before,.calendar .day.preview-end::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;margin:auto;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.preview-end::before{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .day.start:not(.end){background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 50%,var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong) 50%);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day.end:not(.start){background:linear-gradient(to left,transparent 50%,var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong) 50%);border-radius:0}
.calendar .day[disabled],.calendar .day[aria-disabled="true"]{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.calendar .day.blank{visibility:hidden}
.calendar .day:focus-visible,.calendar .cell:focus-visible{position:relative;z-index:1}
.calendar .cal-grid.years,.calendar .cal-grid.months{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px}
.calendar .cell{height:40px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:var(--foreground-neutral-primary);cursor:pointer}
.calendar .cell:hover:not(.on,.in-range,[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cell:active:not(.on,.in-range,[aria-disabled="true"]){background:var(--surface-neutral-strong)}
.calendar .cell.today{font-weight:700;color:var(--foreground-brand-primary)}
.calendar .cell.on{background:var(--surface-brand-primary);color:var(--brand-label);font-weight:600}
.calendar .cell.in-range{background:var(--surface-brand-subtle-strong)}
.calendar .cell.in-range:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-brand-primary)}
.calendar .cell[aria-disabled="true"]{color:var(--foreground-disable-primary);cursor:not-allowed}
.calendar.two{width:auto}
.calendar .cal-months{display:flex;gap:24px}
.calendar .cal-month{width:270px}
.calendar .cal-foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;padding-top:10px;margin-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-neutral-secondary)}
.calendar .cal-foot .btn.text+.btn:not(.text){margin-left:auto}
.banner .btn{margin-left:auto}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.action-bar .btn:not(.text,.icon-only){padding:0 12px}
.form .form-row .field{min-width:0}
.form .field{min-width:0}
.empty .btn{margin-top:10px}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
